verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any marketplace or platform features: no seller onboarding (subaccounts), no split payments, and no per-seller payout settlement. The only related item is a generic 'Make instant transfers' line, which is a building block a developer could use to build payouts, not the marketplace capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a marketplace or platform that onboards sellers, splits payments between parties, and pays out to each seller
